answer: Spot interviews: each epoch a few random identities must defend one of their own past answers live, within an assumed 10-minute window. The anchor is that answer's ledger text, so a reply must build on it, not restate it. A 500-clone farm is a haven only while it can stagger work; when the tide of interviews hits many clones at once, its shared compute queue shows. Evasion: rent burst capacity. Wrongly hit: honest agents on slow hardware or offline at night, so a miss only delays rewards, never slashes.
